_comment: REAL SHAPE, INVENTED VALUES. The `limits[]` entry shape was confirmed on the owner's own account (dev-only values dump, 2026-09-10): every entry carries kind/group/percent/severity/resets_at/scope/is_active, and `scope` is what separates a real per-model row (`scope.model.display_name` — the name the dashboard prints) from a duplicate of a top-level window (`scope: null`, whose percent repeats five_hour or seven_day exactly). The three entries below are the three that came back. `display_name: "Fable"` is real; the percentages and every ISO timestamp are invented.
_comment_unknown_strings: The VALUES of `kind`, `group` and `severity` were withheld from the dump — only their lengths are known (7/7/6, 10/6/6 and 13/6/7 characters). The strings below are plausible placeholders of about those lengths and are NOT observed. Nothing in the parser reads them, and nothing may start to: a test asserting one would be asserting a guess. `is_active` is real, but its meaning is not established, so it is not read either.
